_note: Only our own measurements, copied from the development notes. Never round up, never fill a gap: unknown fields say so. 'build' is the compiler profile: 'Release' is the optimised build people get.

machines.dev: Ryzen 7 5800X · 32 GB · RTX 3090 · NVMe SSD, Windows 11

groups.title: The window never waits
groups.lede: How long the interface was blocked, before and after the change that fixed it. Lower is better.

rows.what: Fix all on a scene with 43 findings: window frozen
rows.method: Fix all on a real saved scene, timed in an optimised build
rows.notes: Whole job 3.94 s → 2.12 s; the result is identical bit for bit.

rows.what: First click on a freshly imported 1.9 M-triangle miniature
rows.method: Time from click to selection, first click after import
Timing test that imports the same 4 files, repeated

rows.what: Paste a copy of a 1.9 M-triangle miniature
rows.method: Each Ctrl+V timed on the same model; the new time no longer varies
rows.notes: Undo of a paste: 83–108 ms → 0.1 ms.

rows.what: Add one support by hand on a large scene
rows.method: One click with the Add tool, timed from click to the support on screen
rows.notes: The click now runs off the interface thread, so the window stays live meanwhile.

groups.title: Big jobs
groups.lede: Wall-clock time for whole operations. Lower is better.

rows.what: Import 4 models into an empty scene
rows.method: Same 4 files, read in parallel in one job
rows.notes: Into a scene that already has models: 8.1–9.5 s → 2.6–2.8 s.

rows.method: Start and end of the step in the app's diagnostic log

rows.what: Slice 991 layers of that miniature with supports
rows.method: Diagnostic log, ELEGOO Saturn 3 Ultra at 0.1 mm layers
Diagnostic log, .ctb for the Saturn 3 Ultra
Benchmark of the hollowing engine, two interleaved runs
rows.notes: Live cavity preview 300–325 → 182–190 ms; dragging the wall slider 156–165 → 63–68 ms.

rows.method: Median over the broken meshes of our repair test set
rows.notes: Median per file 0.59 s; the slowest, 2.5 M faces, 7.2 s.

rows.method: The app's worker, timed by a test; other builds were compiling on the machine
rows.notes: Analysis done once when the tool opens: 0.33 s.

rows.what: Fill bed with copies of a small model
rows.method: Fill bed timed in the app
rows.notes: A 1.9 M-triangle miniature: 11 copies in 0.49 s.

groups.title: Viewport
groups.lede: Frame times while the camera moves. Higher frames per second is better.

rows.method: Preferences › UI & Theme › Test performance, run by hand on the same scene

rows.what: 8 copies of a 1.9 M-triangle miniature, camera turning
rows.method: Viewport benchmark at 1080p; other work running on the machine

rows.what: Dragging a model: bounding box per frame
rows.method: Viewport benchmark; the box comes from the model's convex hull and is identical to the full walk

groups.title: Start-up
groups.lede: From launching the program to a visible window.

rows.method: Phase marks recorded by the app (also in Export Diagnostics)

rows.what: Window visible, first launch of a new build
rows.method: Same phase marks; includes the antivirus scan of a new executable
rows.notes: A signed release build is expected to skip most of that scan; not measured yet.
